_doc: Known faults of the calibration reader (scripts/computed-route/lib/calibrate-read.mjs::readInstancesInPage). A reference part matching an entry is listed in the score's referenceFaults and scored neither for nor against the scan. Delete an entry when the reader is fixed.

faults.reason: The reader records a ::first-letter layer whenever any TEXT_PSEUDO_PROPS value differs from the element's own; opacity does not inherit, so every text element whose opacity is not 1 gains a ::first-letter that no rule paints (its only recorded values are opacity 1 and float none).

The reader records ::placeholder on every input and textarea, whether or not any rule styles it or the input can show one (a file input draws none), so a measured ::placeholder part is no evidence either way.
